description: Building a startup app from scratch in a fast-paced environment.
points: Driving end-to-end Flutter development for a startup app built from the ground up, working directly with founders to shape product direction and feature priorities
Integrated Firebase services including Authentication and Cloud Messaging to power core app functionality, user onboarding and engagement
Implemented Razorpay payment integration and push notification workflows, alongside WhatsApp and Email API integrations for user communication
Contributed to the Next.js admin panel, building features that support backend operations alongside the core mobile app
Operating in a fast-paced startup environment with high ownership, balancing rapid iteration with production-quality code

description: Built core Flutter features for a B2B jewellery marketplace platform, connecting manufacturers with retailers through catalog browsing, order management and real-time order tracking.
points: Architected the authentication and onboarding experience, including OTP auto-fill login and a multi-language onboarding flow, reducing signup friction for first-time users

Redesigned the product catalog UI, refactoring a toggle-based category switch into a scalable TabBar system supporting Bulk, Mass and Single product flows, with Google Maps integration for location-aware browsing
Built complex catalog features end-to-end including Bulk Product Listing APIs with deep navigation, an API-driven Coupon Card system, and an advanced weight-based filtering engine for sellers
Independently designed and shipped the app's Home page from Figma to production, including an interactive Weight Range selector and personalized product discovery sections
